@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: I really can't afford to put off writing this paper anymore. The d______e is tomorrow afternoon!
= deadline
~詞義 deadline（n.）最後期限
~原文 I really can't afford to put off writing this paper anymore. The deadline is tomorrow afternoon!

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The mountain offered a m______t view of the sunrise that made the long, exhausting climb completely worthwhile.
= magnificent
~詞義 magnificent（adj.）壯觀的
~原文 The mountain offered a magnificent view of the sunrise that made the long, exhausting climb completely worthwhile.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The poor girl became an o______n at the age of six, when her parents died in a terrible fire.
= orphan
~詞義 orphan（n.）孤兒
~原文 The poor girl became an orphan at the age of six, when her parents died in a terrible fire.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The group of friends ate lunch under the s______e of a large maple tree, enjoying cool air on the hot summer afternoon.
= shade
~詞義 shade（n.）陰涼處
~原文 The group of friends ate lunch under the shade of a large maple tree, enjoying cool air on the hot summer afternoon.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Many of the s______rs in America originally came from Europe.
= settlers
~詞義 settler（n.）移居者
~原文 Many of the settlers in America originally came from Europe.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ couldn't stand the loud noises in the café and started to cry.
A: ferry
B: kettle
C: infant
D: chamber
= C
~詞義 infant（n.）嬰兒
~原文 The infant couldn't stand the loud noises in the café and started to cry.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Eddie played the Chinese flute in the ______ in high school.
A: catalogue
B: orchestra
C: refugee
D: bankruptcy
= B
~詞義 orchestra（n.）管弦樂團
~原文 Eddie played the Chinese flute in the orchestra in high school.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The peaceful afternoon changed in the ______ of an eye when dark storm clouds suddenly covered the sky.
A: feast
B: fax
C: blink
D: sketch
= C
~詞義 blink（n.）眨眼
~原文 The peaceful afternoon changed in the blink of an eye when dark storm clouds suddenly covered the sky.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ car crash took the lives of more than four people.
A: elastic
B: fatal
C: needy
D: partial
= B
~詞義 fatal（adj.）致命的
~原文 The fatal car crash took the lives of more than four people.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: With the economy going into recession, the company eventually went ______.
A: bankrupt
B: elegant
C: flexible
D: magnificent
= A
~詞義 bankrupt（adj.）破產的
~原文 With the economy going into recession, the company eventually went bankrupt.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: hardship
B: chemistry
C: scolded
D: cue
E: elastic
F: gifted

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The bus was about to leave, and on ______, Jason ran up to the stop, out of breath.
= D
~詞義 cue（n.）恰在這時(on cue)
~原文 The bus was about to leave, and on cue, Jason ran up to the stop, out of breath.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Our ancestors went through a lot of ______ to create the world that we live in now.
= A
~詞義 hardship（n.）艱難
~原文 Our ancestors went through a lot of hardship to create the world that we live in now.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Patrick was ______ by the teacher because he had skipped school again.
= C
~詞義 scold（v.）責罵
~原文 Patrick was scolded by the teacher because he had skipped school again.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Martin is a(n) ______ musician who has performed in many big concert halls.
= F
~詞義 gifted（adj.）富天賦的
~原文 Martin is a(n) gifted musician who has performed in many big concert halls.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Jack majored in ______ in college, and now he teaches science in a junior high school.
= B
~詞義 chemistry（n.）化學
~原文 Jack majored in chemistry in college, and now he teaches science in a junior high school.

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: To be a good ______, you need to be skilled with numbers and have good attention to detail.
= A
~詞義 accountant（n.）會計師
~原文 To be a good accountant, you need to be skilled with numbers and have good attention to detail.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Judging by his ______, the man probably comes from Ireland.
= B
~詞義 accent（n.）口音
~原文 Judging by his accent, the man probably comes from Ireland.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: My grandmother was a very ______ woman who always dressed beautifully.
= E
~詞義 elegant（adj.）優雅的
~原文 My grandmother was a very elegant woman who always dressed beautifully.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: My mother prepared a(n) ______ for Christmas dinner.
= F
~詞義 feast（n.）盛宴
~原文 My mother prepared a(n) feast for Christmas dinner.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The dance instructor waved her hand, and then the music ______.
= C
~詞義 cease（v.）停止
~原文 The dance instructor waved her hand, and then the music ceased.
